test_enable_errors: test the jax_utils.enable_errors context manager to enable or disable error checking in JAX computations
test_get_dtype: test the jax_utils.get_dtype function to retrieve the default JAX dtype based on the JAX_PRECISION environment variable
test_batched_cond: test the jax_utils.batched_cond function to conditionally apply true or false branch functions over batched operands
test_while_loop_bounded: test the jax_utils.while_loop_bounded function to run a bounded while loop with output history and gradient support
test_get_number_of_compiles: test the jax_utils.get_number_of_compiles function to count the number of JAX compilations for a jit-decorated function
